summary: Tiptree Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a merger involving its subsidiary Fortegra Group, acquired by DB Insurance Co., Ltd. in a going-private transaction. Tiptree common stock was delisted from Nasdaq upon closing. The filing includes credit facility amendments consenting to the change of control. No specific financial terms or per-share price were disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction closed on May 29, 2026. Watch for final shareholder consideration details and any post-closing litigation.
